cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, "There are still too many men." He has Gideon take the ten thousand down to the water so He can sift them there.
cards.verse_text: Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there.
cards.snippet: Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there.

cards.card_text: Back to the throne: Solomon says a king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.
cards.verse_text: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.
cards.snippet: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.

cards.card_text: The LORD comes to sift His own people in a sieve of destruction.
cards.verse_text: He comes to sift the nations in a sieve of destruction; He bridles the jaws of the peoples to lead them astray.
cards.snippet: He comes to sift the nations in a sieve of destruction; He bridles the jaws of…

cards.card_text: It's the nations He sifts, and His breath is like a rushing torrent that rises to the neck.
cards.verse_text: He comes to sift the nations in a sieve of destruction; He bridles the jaws of the peoples to lead them astray.

cards.card_text: This searing wind is blowing to winnow and sift.
cards.verse_text: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A searing wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift; a wind too strong for that comes from Me.
cards.snippet: …toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift; a wind too strong for that comes from Me.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says He'll give the command and shake the house of Israel among all the nations, as grain is sifted in a sieve.
cards.verse_text: “For surely I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve; but not a pebble will reach the ground.
cards.snippet: …shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve; but not a pebble will reach the ground.

cards.card_text: “Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.”
cards.verse_text: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat.
